caption: The drawing features a large, rectangular white stone structure positioned centrally in the foreground, with small red marks on its top surface. Surrounding the stone structure are five human figures, some partially visible, depicted with pale skin and dark or reddish clothing; three are grouped together on the left, one is on the right holding a long, narrow object, and another figure is partially visible behind the structure. The background is dominated by a large green mound or hill extending across most of the width of the image. Behind the green mound, the sky and distant landscape are filled with brown tones, and several vertical, tree-like dark shapes rise against the backdrop. The colors in the composition are predominantly earthy—with browns, greens, whites, and flesh tones—applied with visible brushstrokes.
title: Station of the Cross No. 14: "Jesus is Laid in His Tomb"
